context.text: I'm trying to decide on a new programming language to learn. I've been doing some research, but I'm having trouble deciding between Python and R. I graduated with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from UCLA exactly 5 years ago, so I have a solid foundation in programming principles, but I'm not sure which language would be more beneficial for my career. Can you give me some insights on the pros and cons of each language?

I've been slacking off on my exercise routine during my week-long beach vacation, and I'm looking to get back on track. I've been doing a lot of jogging and cycling lately, and I'd love to explore yoga classes or studios in my area to mix things up. Can you help me with that?

I've been experimenting with nutritional yeast a lot lately, and it's been a game-changer for me. I added it to my vegan lentil soup and it gave it a cheesy flavor without the dairy. Do you have any recommendations for other ingredients that can give a cheesy flavor to dishes?

I'm excited to try out these recipes and experiment with cashew cheese powder. I've been wanting to perfect my vegan mac and cheese recipe, and I think this could be the key. Speaking of perfecting recipes, I've been meaning to ask: do you have any tips on meal prep and planning? I've started meal prepping on Sundays to make my weekdays easier, but I'm always looking for ways to optimize my process.

I think I'll go with the Eurostar train from London to Paris, it sounds like a great way to see the countryside. Also, I'm interested in the Hotel Le Royal Monceau Raffles Paris for our stay in Paris. Can you tell me more about the hotel and what kind of amenities they offer for families? By the way, I've been doing a lot of traveling lately and I'm trying to maximize my frequent flyer miles, do you know if American Airlines has any partnerships with European airlines that might help me earn more miles on these flights?

That sounds great about the hotel and the Eurostar train! I'm really looking forward to that part of the trip. For the flights, I'll make sure to book through American Airlines or its partners to maximize my miles. By the way, I've been doing a lot of traveling lately, and I just got back from a quick getaway to Miami with my friends over Presidents' Day weekend. We stayed at the Fontainebleau hotel, which was really nice.
I've been flying so much lately, I'm glad I've been able to rack up those miles. Speaking of which, do you think I could use my Gold Medallion status to upgrade my seat on this flight?

By the way, I've been flying so much lately, I'm starting to lose track of my trips. I think I've taken around 5 domestic flights in the past month, and I've been on a plane every 2-3 weeks for the past 3 months. Do you think you could help me keep track of my travel history and expenses?

I think that's a great idea. I'll make sure to remind my audience about my weekly live streaming schedule. By the way, I've been trying to prioritize my Instagram streams a bit more lately because I've noticed that they've been getting more views than my YouTube streams. Do you think that's because Instagram's algorithm gives more visibility to live content?

I think I'll have to weigh my options carefully. I've been playing a lot of games lately, including The Last of Us Part II, which I just replayed on hard difficulty, and I think a good gaming chair could really enhance my experience. But I also need to consider my budget and whether or not the Acer Predator chair is worth the investment.
